title: DynamoDB bulk put items is now available
description: You can now use bulk put items to load data from Amazon S3 into an existing DynamoDB table without consuming read or write capacity on that table. Bulk put items offers two performance tiers, Standard and Accelerated, to match your workload requirements. For more information, see DynamoDB bulk put items: how it works.

title: Amazon RDS reports snapshot storage charges at per-snapshot granularity
description: Amazon RDS now attributes snapshot storage charges to each snapshot individually in AWS Cost Explorer and your AWS Cost and Usage Report. The ResourceId field shows the Amazon RDS snapshot ARN, or the Amazon RDS cluster snapshot ARN for Multi-AZ DB cluster snapshots. Your pricing and overall charges are unchanged. title: Announcing Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
description:
Today, we are announcing the general availability of Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Web Answer is a managed tool that returns a synthesized, grounded, cited answer to a natural-language question in a single call, so agent builders can attach it to an agent and get back a finished answer grounded in current web sources, without building and maintaining their own search, retrieve, synthesis, and citation pipeline.
